rungs.title: Marketing Assistant
rungs.summary: Learning the brand, the channels and how campaigns run.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the products, the audience and the main channels.
rungs.delivery: Supports campaigns: schedules, reports and routine tasks.
rungs.leadership: Keeps good records and asks for coaching.

rungs.title: Marketing Executive
rungs.summary: Runs campaigns and channels day to day.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in the funnel, email, ads and basic analytics.
rungs.delivery: Plans and runs campaigns with a budget and reports the results.
rungs.leadership: Works with sales, content and design to hit a shared target.

rungs.title: Marketing Manager
rungs.summary: Owns a channel mix, a budget and the results.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in attribution, audience and the economics of acquisition.
rungs.delivery: Owns a budget and a target; shows return on spend.
rungs.leadership: Manages people and agencies; aligns with sales on lead quality.

rungs.title: Senior Marketing Manager
rungs.summary: Owns the marketing plan across products and markets.
rungs.knowledge: Connects brand, product and pricing to the market.
rungs.delivery: Owns the plan, budget and pipeline contribution of several channels.
rungs.leadership: Leads managers and negotiates priorities with sales and product.

rungs.title: Head of Marketing
rungs.summary: Sets marketing strategy and owns the brand.
rungs.knowledge: Reads the market, the numbers and what AI changes in marketing.
rungs.delivery: Owns marketing strategy, brand and the pipeline target.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and speaks for the market at the top table.
